AmplifAI Max AI Coaching Software 
AmplifAI Max AI Coaching Practice Partner for Your Agents 
Max AI Coach builds a practice session from an agent's last 100 evaluated interactions, showing how a high performer handles them, role-playing the conversation live, scoring the practice run with evidence from their own words. Your team leaders coach sessions changing careers, while Max drills tactical reps between customer interactions.

Max AI Coach Use Cases 
Session BriefingHigh-Performer ComparisonVoice Role-PlayEvidence-Scored DebriefAgent and Leader Dashboards 
Agent Practice Sessions Start With Why 
Max AI Coach opens each practice session with an agent's last 100 evaluated interactions and Auto QA scores against team and top-performer benchmarks, landing on one finding that explains their performance gap, like a denial reason quoted before any empathy statement in 63 of 100 calls. 
Quality ManagementCX Intelligence 
Cohort strips show which calls, date range, and QA form built the session.
End-of-call sentiment and repeat-call rate from customer analytics sit next to Auto QA scores.
Strengths appear alongside gaps, with sessions reading fair and earning agent trust.
Agent's Hear Their Call Next to a High Performer's 
Max plays short clips from the agent's customer conversations side by side with the matched moment from a high performer's call, the agent hears the difference in real dialogue, not a description on a form. 
Auto QAPerformance Management 
Clips carry their source call, QA dimension score, and end sentiment.
High-performer exemplars come from a browsable library of your organization's best conversations.
Two or three moments per session keep the focus on the behaviors that move the metric.
Agents Get to Rehearse Hard Conversations Before They Count 
Max plays the customer in a live voice role-play built on the exact scenario the evidence surfaced, staying in character through the whole conversation, the agent gets a rep between customer interactions without a live customer on the line. 
Contact Center AICoaching 
Voice-based role-play runs from the agent's dashboard in the minutes between interactions.
Max holds the customer persona through off-script turns, confusion, and meta questions.
Resolving the customer's issue earns a natural close, matching how real conversations end.
Practice Run Scores Quote the Agent's Own Words 
Max scores the practice run against anchored rubrics and backs the marks with verbatim quotes from the agent's turns, a strong run earns credit it can prove and a rushed run gets called out honestly. 
CoachingPerformance Management 
Effort gating separates a full attempt from a breeze-through, with capped scores and a redo invitation.
Evidence quotes under each rubric dimension show the exact line that earned the score.
Debrief results feed the next person-to-person coaching session with the agent's progress already mapped.
Max Lives on Dashboards Agents and Leaders Already Use 
Max AI Coach greets agents on their dashboard with a plain-language read of how today is going and one behavior to work on, answers questions about their metrics in an interactive chat, and shows team leaders which agents are practicing and improving. 
Performance ManagementCoaching 
Daily briefings translate the morning's metrics into one focused suggestion per agent.
Interactive chat answers an agent's questions from their own performance data.
Team-leader views show practice activity, completions, and runs worth a human follow-up. 
Max AI Coach Features and Capabilities 
Practice between customer interactions, built from each agent's own calls 
Max AI Coach runs AmplifAI's AI coaching simulation: evidence briefings from each agent's own calls, top-performer moments, live voice role-play, level-one coaching, and escalation to the team leader when practice shows a person is needed. 
AI Coaching Simulation Agents practice between customer interactions with Max, AmplifAI’s AI coaching simulation, using their calls, top-performer moments, and live voice role-play, with Max escalating the session to a team leader when agent practice requires human coaching. 
 AI Coaching Simulation capabilities 
Capability
What it does 
AI Coaching Simulation
Max, AmplifAI’s AI coaching simulation, leads scheduled or on-demand sessions that review agent KPIs and recent calls, replay moments where an agent missed a behavior, compare those moments with top-performer examples from a matching call type, and role-play an improved approach. Max sends supervisors a session summary and feeds the results into performance tracking.
Evidence Briefing
Max opens AI coaching simulation sessions with evidence explaining the focus, including the agent’s scored calls, QA results compared with top-performer results, and target behavior for practice.
Top-Performer Moments
Max plays a short clip from an agent’s recent call, then a corresponding moment from a top performer on a matching call type, and explains the behavioral difference.
Live Voice Practice
Max plays the customer while agents practice scenarios aloud, reacting to agent responses and staying in character when conversations go off script. Agents repeat the scenario as many times as needed.
AI Coaching Simulation Escalations
When AI coaching simulation practice doesn't provide intended improvements, the transcript reaches the team leader as a coaching task with what to coach next.
Max Level-One Coaching
Routine coaching goes straight to the agent as a simulation coaching session with Max, and a team leader steps in only when the practice shows they're needed.
Top-Performer Library
Max maintains a browsable library of top-performer call moments from your organization, explains why the moments represent high performance, and lets users filter examples by behavior, industry, and call type.

Max AI Coaching FAQ 
Frequently asked questions. 
Answers for coaching and CX leaders evaluating AmplifAI's Max AI Coaching. 
Is Max AI Coach Secure and Compliant With AmplifAI Standards? 
Yes, Max runs on the same AmplifAI platform controls: SOC 2 Type II compliance, encryption in transit and at rest, and role-based access across coaching, performance, and quality data. For full details, visit the AmplifAI Trust and Compliance page. 
Can Team Leaders See Max Practice Results in AmplifAI? 
Yes, team leaders see practice activity, debrief scorecards, and progress trends on their AmplifAI dashboard, next to the coaching histories and Coaching Effectiveness Scores (CEfx) they already use. Max flags the practice runs worth a human follow-up, leaders spend their sessions where practice showed the agent needs a coach. 
How Does Max AI Coach Score Practice Sessions in AmplifAI? 
Max AI Coach scores each rubric dimension against anchored examples of what strong and weak look like on the session's call type, requires a verbatim quote from the agent's practice turns for any high score, and gates scores on effort, with a one-word run-through scoring near zero and a full attempt earning fair, evidenced marks. 
Is Max Ai Coach Available in AmplifAI Today? 
Yes, Max is rolling out across AmplifAI customers now, with agent and team-leader dashboard widgets arriving first and guided practice sessions following as the rollout expands. Talk to your AmplifAI customer success team to get started with Max. 
What Data Does Max AI Coach Use From AmplifAI? 
Max AI Coach builds sessions from the agent's evaluated interactions in AmplifAI, including Auto QA form scores, conversation analytics, end-of-call sentiment, CSAT, and repeat-call signals. Claims in a briefing trace to scored calls, and exemplars come from recorded high-performer conversations in your organization 
Does Max AI Coach Replace Human Coaches For AmplifAI Customers? 
Person-to-person coaching stays the center of the AmplifAI coaching model, while Max handles the tactical practice reps coaches don't have time to run, including debriefs for your coaches with a mapped starting point, keeping coaching time on coaching, not planning.

Trust, Security, and Compliance 
Quality and customer data handled to the standards regulated industries require. 
Visit the AmplifAI Trust and Compliance page 
Security at the data layer 
AmplifAI runs on internally hosted LLMs, so your data never touches public APIs and is never used to train models for other customers. Access is governed by SSO with Okta and Azure AD and role-based controls, so agents see only their own data, in a logically separated environment with no commingling between customers. 
AES-256 
encryption in transit and at rest 
Compliance at the core 
AmplifAI maintains the certifications highly regulated industries require, including healthcare and finance. Built on Microsoft Azure and working with AWS and GCP, it can be deployed inside your cloud infrastructure, with data region-locked to specific geographic locations.
